content.title: Chevron Is Loading Venezuela Oil Onto Tankers at the Fastest Pace in Months
content.summary: Chevron loaded 1.68 million barrels of Venezuelan oil onto ships during the first week of this month, the most for that period since May, according to vessel movements tracked by Bloomberg.  Chevron’s accelerated tanker loadings come as Venezuelan crude-storage facilities near full capacity.
